name: DROID
summary: 大规模真实机器人操作数据集，覆盖多地点、多操作者和多种日常场景，提供同步视觉、动作、语言与机器人状态，适合研究真实世界中的通用操作策略和动作条件世界模型。
license: Dataset terms apply; verify downstream and third-party restrictions
verdict: 多场景真实机器人轨迹
wmNote: 适合研究跨场景操作和动作条件转移；不同采集地点带来有价值的分布差异，也增加了数据清洗与标定成本。
summaryEn: A large real-world robot manipulation dataset spanning many sites, operators, and everyday scenes, with synchronized vision, actions, language, and robot state.
wmNoteEn: Valuable for cross-scene manipulation and action-conditioned transitions. Site diversity improves coverage but increases calibration and cleaning requirements.
scaleZh: 7.6 万条轨迹 · 350 小时 · 564 个场景 · 86 项任务
organizationsZh: 斯坦福大学牵头的 DROID 协作团队
licenseZh: 适用数据集专用条款；需核查下游使用及第三方内容限制

evidence.sourceTitle: DROID: A Large-Scale In-the-Wild Robot Manipulation Dataset
evidence.statement: Official dataset quickstart iterates per-step robot observations; the release documents teleoperated manipulation demonstration collection.
